gii_ranking_text: Cambodia ranks 103rd among the 136 economies featured in the GII 2024.
lead_summary:
Explore IP Landscape:
Cambodia has been a member of WIPO since 1995 and is a signatory to over 9 WIPO treaties.
The national IP offices of Cambodia are the Department of Copyright and Related rights at the Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts, the Department of Industrial Property (DIP) at the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation and the Department of Intellectual Property at the Ministry of Commerce. The offices are located in Phnom Penh.
